mapper.insert: insert into ssd_query_template_asset_change_apply ( tpl_id, view_id, apply_remark, approval_status, approval_remark, is_active, created_by, created_time ) values ( #{tplId}, #{viewId}, #{applyRemark}, #{approvalStatus}, #{approvalRemark}, 1, #{createdBy}, now() )
mapper.select: select count(1) from ssd_query_template_asset_change_apply where view_id = #{viewId} and approval_status = 'apply'
mapper.update: update ssd_query_template_asset_change_apply set approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, approval_remark = #{approvalRemark}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_time = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = now() where apply_id = #{applyId}
update ssd_query_template_asset_change_apply set approval_status = 'revoke', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = now() where apply_id = #{applyId}
mapper.select: select apply_id as applyId, tpl_id as tplId, view_id as viewId, apply_remark as applyRemark, approval_status as approvalStatus, approval_remark as approvalRemark, approved_by as approvedBy, DATE_FORMAT( approved_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as approvedTime, created_by as createdBy, DATE_FORMAT( created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as createdTime, concat(ROUND( ( UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW()) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created_time) ) / 3600 ,1) ,'h') AS applyPendingTime from ssd_query_template_asset_change_apply where apply_id = #{applyId}
